title: Managing the attention span
caption: You can't read a gauge, so you build habits.
handoff: Handoff: party for 40, 27 June, <budget>budget 40,000 €</budget>. Next: invitations.

you-manage-by-habit.title: You manage by habit
you-manage-by-habit.script: You made it, almost. Just one more thing, and yes, that rotten apple grinning at you is a wink at context rot. You can't read a gauge, so you build habits. First the everyday ones, and then the one for a big project.
